title: Dependency Healthboard: automated interteam readiness and escalation for roadmap cutovers
creator: Evan Torres
description:
Problem: Cross-team dependency visibility for roadmap milestones is fragmented. Engineering, Design, Security, and Infra each surface readiness signals in different places (Jira/Linear, Figma/Design handoffs, security gating tickets, infra capacity dashboards). This causes late discovery of blockers during cutover windows and manual, ad-hoc escalation loops.

Goal: Ship a lightweight "Dependency Healthboard" that aggregates readiness signals, produces a normalized risk score per dependency, and automates escalation rules for cutover readiness checks. The healthboard must integrate with Linear ticket statuses, Console readiness metrics, Security gating, and infra capacity forecasts.

Success metrics: 50% reduction in late-stage (<=2 weeks) dependency discoveries for Q2 launches; 30% faster remediation time for blocked cutovers; adoption by >3 product initiatives in Q2 pilot.
proposed_solution:
1) Define a normalized dependency schema (owner, impact blast radius, readiness indicator sources, SLA to unblock). 2) Build a lightweight ingestion pipeline that pulls: Linear issue status, Console route/model readiness (api), infra capacity forecast (Prometheus/BigQuery), security review ticket states. 3) Implement a scoring function (readiness_score: 0-100) with weighted signals and a freshness window. 4) Surface results in a dedicated Console dashboard and an automated weekly digest with per-dependency actions and auto-created follow-up tasks when score < threshold. 5) Implement escalation playbooks (email/Slack/Linear issue create) for high-impact blocked dependencies.

Notes on scope: Start with roadmap cutovers only (critical releases), pilot with two product initiatives and one Dedicated capacity migration. Keep gating rules configurable by project owner.
acceptance_criteria: Schema for dependency objects documented and approved by Eng/Design/Security/Infra
Automated ingestion running every 6 hours for Linear and Console signals
Readiness scoring implemented in a service with unit tests and a public formula
Console dashboard shows dependency list, score, owner, last_updated, and next_action
Escalation automation creates Linear tickets or Slack alerts for score < 40 for high-impact items
Pilot used by at least 2 initiatives and feedback collected in retrospective
